li.label: water-disciplined
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was raised where every swallow of water is counted and every calorie has an owner. {PAWN_pronoun} needs less than other people, sleeps lightly and efficiently, and finds waste quietly offensive.

li.label: sand-stoic
li.description: The deep desert does not reward complaint. {PAWN_nameDef} treats pain as weather: noted, endured, and never discussed. It takes a great deal to make {PAWN_objective} stop walking, and more to make {PAWN_objective} break.

li.label: numbered
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew up as a designation, not a name. Insults slide off someone who was never quite a person to their superiors, and {PAWN_pronoun} almost never starts a fight — but warmth comes slowly, when it comes at all.

li.label: laconic
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} says what needs saying and not one word more. People who work by a code find most conversation to be noise, and most provocation to be somebody else's problem.

li.label: reaps the flames
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} does not fear fire; {PAWN_pronoun} reaps it. Burning the Pyrelands reveals food, and burning what does not belong — a settlement, a vehicle, an offworlder — is doctrine, not cruelty. Sand is safety; it does not burn.

li.label: ash-judgment
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} reads what regrew after the burning — who returned, who fled, who was never worth the ash. {PAWN_possessive} judgment of belonging carries weight the tribe does not question, and {PAWN_pronoun} eases or hardens the road for anyone the tribe is deciding whether to keep.

li.label: shore-hardened
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} spent childhood breathing whatever the tide brought in. {PAWN_possessive} body learned to shrug off what would sicken someone raised clean.

li.label: still-temper
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is easiest to live with when the stills are running and the fuel stores are full — and worst when a still stands cold with nothing to crack. {PAWN_pronoun} has never fully forgiven an empty tank.

li.label: line-tapper
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} walked the Free Droid Enclaves' fuel lines in every weather the terminator has, tapping what the Junkers needed. {PAWN_pronoun} tolerates cold most people cannot — and the droids that keep the count remember every tap.

li.label: racer's reflexes
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has the reaction time of someone who has taken a repulsor sled through a canyon at speeds that should be fatal. {PAWN_pronoun} moves and dodges like a rumor — and has never once been accused of patience at a firing line.
